title: Mitigating Dataset Harms Requires Stewardship: Lessons from 1000 Papers
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith/religion. Its analysis focuses on ethical harms like privacy, bias, and unethical applications in face and person recognition datasets.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. The analysis of dataset harms, such as biased annotations and representational harms, focuses on demographic categories like gender and race, without mentioning religious groups or attributes.
